title: Advanced Topics Practice 2
statement:
Module 5 (Advanced Topics) covers: transactions and acid, indexes deep dive, explain and query tuning, window functions in depth, stored procedures and functions, database security. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Indexes Deep Dive).
hints: Re-read the Indexes Deep Dive lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
